gallery.filename: Painted terracotta tile from Baba Jan 4.jpg
gallery.title: File:Painted terracotta tile from Baba Jan 4.jpg
gallery.description: Painted terracotta tile from Baba Jan, Luristan, Iran. 800-700 BC. One of 176 tiles found in a ceremonial building next to a fort, the ceiling of which had collapsed following a fire in about 700 BC.  The pattern may be inspired by textiles.
categories: Ancient Near East in the Ashmolean Museum
Art of Iran in the Ashmolean Museum
Photographs of museum objects by Andrew West
